body:
Hi!

We will take a look.

This reads similar to CI failures that began mid-July on our Intel Windows runners only. We see failures on both windows-2025 and windows-2022. We also see it on the Xeon 8370C too. It's causing an alloc-heavy a Go unit test suite to crash from memory corruption. Runs below contain additional hardware info.

Here's a specific failure:
https://github.com/kolide/launcher/actions/runs/30930997739/job/92131851557

And these contain more examples:
 - https://github.com/kolide/launcher/actions/runs/30860321842
 - https://github.com/kolide/launcher/actions/runs/30839386953
